chunks.text: Suppose a car travels 100 meters in say 5 seconds.

chunks.text: In our example, the distance traveled is 100 meters,

chunks.title: Lecture
chunks.text: and the time taken to travel that distance,

chunks.title: Lecture
chunks.text: well, it took 5 seconds to do that.

chunks.title: Lecture
chunks.text: So it's going to be 100 meters divided by 5 seconds.

chunks.title: Lecture
chunks.text: What is 100 by 5? That is 20.

chunks.title: Lecture

chunks.title: Lecture
chunks.text: Well, let's see.

chunks.title: Lecture

chunks.title: Lecture
chunks.text: And it turns out 20 meters per second is roughly around 45 miles per hour.

chunks.title: Lecture

chunks.title: Lecture

chunks.title: Lecture

chunks.title: Lecture
